definitions.active_bin: latest authenticated finalized Ramses active bin

state_machine.monitor: Evaluate on every finalized block while position is open.

proactive_review.action: precompute replacement and executable unwind; do not wait for range escape if replacement economics remain valid.

hard_rebalance.condition: normalized_displacement >= 1.00 OR active_bin outside current range
hard_rebalance.action: burn and remint only if the replacement contract below passes; otherwise exit to USDG/cash.

geometry_failure.condition: current range width < 65 bins OR current position can no longer be fully unwound
geometry_failure.action: rebalance or exit; never add risk simply to rescue the position.

no_displacement_only_churn.condition: normalized_displacement < 0.50 and range remains wide, two-sided, fully unwindable
no_displacement_only_churn.action: hold unless a separately validated economic/inventory trigger fires. Fee spike/drop alone is not a rebalance trigger.

replacement_contract.active_bin_placement: active bin should be inside replacement range; inner 75% of half-width preferred, not mandatory for v1 because some profitable high-step repairs were edge/outside placements.
replacement_contract.no_averaging_down: Do not inject fresh capital after an adverse move. If 80-120% redeployment cannot be achieved, reduce or exit.
replacement_contract.execution_failure: If remint cannot complete within 180 seconds or evidence becomes stale/incomplete, remain in USDG/cash rather than chase.

validation_boundary: Shadow/paper only until exact historical replay and prospective paper validation confirm this rule; protected chronological holdout remains unopened.
